headlines.title: Drinking finally slows after pandemic spike, but not for every age group
headlines.description: Americans are drinking less for the first time since the pandemic, but alcohol use remains higher than it was before 2020, according to a study published Monday in the journal Annals of Internal Medicine.

headlines.title: CDC’s teen behavior report focuses on nutrition, downplays sex and drug use
headlines.description: The new CDC report on teen health focused on high schoolers playing sports and making healthier food choices, priorities for Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

headlines.title: Hundreds of lawsuits filed against some GLP-1 Makers over vision loss
headlines.description: Hundreds of Americans are suing GLP-1 drugmakers Novo Nordisk and Ely Lilly, saying they were not adequately warned of the potential danger of vision loss. In statements, Novo Nordisk says, in part, they are “vigorously” fighting the lawsuits, saying they are “without merit,” while Eli Lilly says in part, it maintains “patient safety” is its “top priority.” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

headlines.title: The Surprising Clues Your Feet May Reveal About Your Health
headlines.description: As your body’s foundation, issues with your feet can create a domino effect with the rest of your health. Dr. Ebonie Vincent-Sleet, podiatrists and one of the stars of TLC’s “My Feet Are Killing Me,” joins TODAY to break down remedies for common issues, when you should see a doctor, and the possible warning signs your feet could be giving you about diabetes, heart failure and more.

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro suggests Trump should oust HHS Secretary RFK Jr. amid measles fight
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with NBC News' Allan Smith, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said “no” when asked if he would change anything about his response to the measles outbreak in his state. A spokesperson for the Department of Health and Human Services responding: "Governor Shapiro’s accusations are false and irresponsible. Under Secretary Kennedy’s leadership, CDC has mounted an aggressive measles response."

headlines.title: Florida couple says IVF resulted in different biological father
headlines.description: Natalie and Joshua Strong say a blood type mismatch raised questions the day after their daughter was born, with DNA testing later confirming Joshua was not her biological father. NBC News’ Kate Snow reports.

headlines.description: People looking to get their annual flu shot this fall may find a new option alongside the usual vaccines: an mRNA flu shot. Not everyone is eligible, however.
